title: U.S. Tracked Alice Huang’s Contacts With China Spy Agency During Nvidia Affair
summary: U.S. intelligence is said to show that the woman at the heart of the A.I. chip scandal was in touch with China’s Ministry of State Security during the period when she was in a relationship with Jensen Huang.
